name: AccuWeb Hosting
tagline: cPanel, Plesk, VPS, dedicated and cloud hosting across 12 global datacenters
description: AccuWeb Hosting is a Linux and Windows hosting provider offering cPanel/Plesk shared hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and cloud hosting with 24/7 support.
about: AccuWeb Hosting runs a wide product line spanning Linux shared hosting (cPanel), Windows shared hosting (Plesk), VPS hosting on both Linux and Windows, dedicated servers, and cloud hosting billed by the hour or month — a broader spread than most budget hosts, which typically stick to Linux-only shared plans.

Linux shared hosting starts with the Basic tier at $3.99/month, including 50GB of pure SSD storage, one website, a full cPanel account, free SSL and free daily backups on LiteSpeed web servers; Premium and Enterprise Pro tiers step up storage and website limits for larger or multi-site accounts. Windows VPS starts separately at $2.99/month with a free Windows license and full admin/RDP access, while Linux VPS opens with the Lite tier at $5.99/month. Dedicated servers start around $110/month on the Classic series and scale up to over $1,150/month for high-spec Advanced configurations; cloud hosting is billed from roughly $3/month on the smallest cl1.Microlet tier.

As with most hosts, the lowest headline price is tied to the longest prepaid term — AccuWeb advertises up to 40% savings on 3-year commitments. Third-party reviews note that AccuWeb's renewal pricing tends to stay closer to its intro pricing than many budget competitors, but confirm the exact renewal rate for your chosen term and billing cycle at checkout before committing, since it wasn't independently verifiable at the time of writing.
policies: AccuWeb Hosting backs shared hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee. VPS hosting carries a shorter 7-day money-back window. Dedicated servers and domain registrations are excluded from any refund guarantee — confirm current terms on AccuWeb's site before purchasing.
